name: Yamamoto Sachie
source:
Classmate of [url=/c6926]Seiji[/url]. People bully her because she is fat, and she has no confidence in herself.
[spoiler]After being raped she decides to take revenge, but before that she diets until she becomes slim.[/spoiler]
